extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy outlines Humana's billing expectations for reporting Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) modifiers XE, XP, XS and XU, known collectively as modifiers X{EPSU}.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Each one of the modifiers X{EPSU} defines a unique subset of distinct procedural services. Modifier 59 is used to report distinct procedural services more generally without the specificity provided by modifiers X{EPSU}. Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) instructions from the American Medical Association (AMA) state that modifier 59 should not be used if a more descriptive modifier is available to report the special circumstances. When one of the modifiers X{EPSU} more accurately describes the circumstances of a distinct procedural service than modifier 59, Humana encourages the reporting of that modifier, instead of modifier 59. Modifiers X{EPSU} should not be appended to evaluation and management (E/M) services.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Each one of the modifiers X{EPSU} defines a unique subset of distinct procedural services. Modifier 59 is used to report distinct procedural services more generally without the specificity provided by modifiers X{EPSU}. Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) instructions from the American Medical Association (AMA) state that modifier 59 should not be used if a more descriptive modifier is available to report the special circumstances. When one of the modifiers X{EPSU} more accurately describes the circumstances of a distinct procedural service than modifier 59, Humana encourages the reporting of that modifier, instead of modifier 59. Modifiers X{EPSU} should not be appended to evaluation and management (E/M) services.

Humana's Making it Easier web-based training series includes a video on the proper reporting of modifiers 59 and X{EPSU} that may supplement your understanding of this policy.

Modifier 59: Distinct procedural service.

Modifier XE: Separate encounter.

Modifier XP: Separate practitioner.

Modifier XS: Separate structure.

Modifier XU: Unusual non-overlapping service.

Modifiers X{EPSU}: Modifiers XE, XP, XS and XU, collectively.
